literal_meaning: কাঁচা (raw/uncooked) খেউড় (a type of wild creeper or vine)
figurative_meaning_bn: অশ্লীল ভাষায় রচিত লেখা গান ইত্যাদি
figurative_meaning_en: Writings, songs, etc., composed in obscene language
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই গানের কথা কাঁচা খেউড়ের মতো অশ্লীল।
তার লেখা কাঁচা খেউড়ের চেয়েও বেশি নোংরা।
example_sentences_in_english: The lyrics of this song are as obscene as raw creeper.
His writing is dirtier than raw creeper.
note: Refers to unrefined, vulgar content akin to wild, untamed plants in Bengali folklore.
